interactive-control widgets

Self-contained fixture — loads amvcp-designmd.js + amvcp-interactive.js only (no runtime). Proves the standalone boot path: the module parses the embedded DESIGN.md, applies --vc-* tokens, injects the foundation bindings, and wires every widget.
